title: File:FreihausInVienna.PNG
credit: Freihaustheater in Wien: 1787-1801 by Tadeusz Krzeszowiak; online at Google.  p. 123
description: Floorplan of the ground floor of the Freihaus, a complex of apartments and businesses in Vienna.  The complex also included the Theater auf der Wieden, site of the premiere of Mozart's opera "The Magic Flute".  The complex is shown as it existed in the late 18th century.  From the State Archives of Lower Austria in St. Poelten.
